A '''species''' of rare [[Bird/Legends|bird]] lived on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aldraig IV]]. At one point, it was [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] nearly to the point of extinction; however, later preservation efforts helped revive its population.

==History==
This rare form of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] inhabited the southern polar region of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Aldraig IV]]. Once [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] nearly to extinction, it later recovered thanks to concerted preservation efforts that allowed the species to repopulate the region.<ref name="TB" />

During the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] company constructed a [[Aldraig IV TIE fighter hull assembly facility|TIE fighter hull assembly facility]] in the recovery area of the rare birds. The construction of the TIE facility threatened the continued survival of the species. Local artist [[Riemann]] believed that using her stature to draw attention to the plight of the birds would help persuade the Empire to aid in their preservation. She staged a peaceful protest that was heavily covered by the media and announced her intention to defy the Empire to protect the birds. The protest was immediately cut short when Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Talloryn]] had Riemann and the protesters arrested, and the news reports were silenced. Briefly incarcerated, Riemann was warned that «agitation» was now a capital offense. Upon her release, she began to assist her fellow activists in secret. Selling her artwork to finance weapons and supplies, Riemann supported the growing underground movement.<ref name="TB" />
